pages.text: A portable life-energy vessel.$(br2)$(bold)Right-click a creature$() to extract its life sample; $(bold)right-click a life-energy block/pipe$() to recharge.$(br2)Weaker creatures are easier to extract: success = base of the creature group + HP bonus (≤50% HP +10%, ≤25% +10% more, capped 95%).

$(bold)Purity$() decides a sample's value and leans low:$(li)60% chance of 0-49$(li)25% chance of 50-74$(li)15% chance of 75-100$(br2)Creature groups also set a gene factor affecting future organ rejection: Warm 0.8 / Undead 1.0 / Explosive 1.1 / End 1.3 / Dragon 1.6.
